question: Should this actor-bound workflow be authorized to reconcile the crawl-remote Cloudflare Access application and publish generation-bound credentials to ClawSweeper and gitcrawl-store?
rationale: The code can be technically correct while the permanent production authority split, named operator, and cross-repository secret scope still require explicit human ownership.

options.title: Approve staged authority
options.body: Approve the dormant bootstrap after confirming its actor, App permissions, repository targets, audit trail, and rollback procedure.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Separate Cloudflare reconciliation from cross-repository credential publication or reduce the repository scope before approval.

options.title: Defer to cutover
options.body: Keep manual provisioning until the slot-aware consumer and migration can be reviewed and landed atomically.

recommendation.title: Approve staged authority
recommendation.body: Approve the dormant bootstrap after confirming its actor, App permissions, repository targets, audit trail, and rollback procedure.

likelyOwner.reason: The exact workflow actor binding and sustained commit history make this the strongest available decision owner.
